name: uidna-mcp
stderr:
Usage: uidna [options] [command]

Reverse-engineer any user interface into a UI DNA document, rebuild it as code
you own, and prove it with a DiffReport.

Options:
  -V, --version                              output the version number
  --json                                     print the evidence envelope as JSON
  --debug                                    verbose diagnostics on stderr
  --out-root <dir>                           directory that holds scans (default ./.uidna)
  --cwd <dir>                                working directory for config and relative paths
  -h, --help                                 display help for command

Commands:
  scan [options] [url]                       Capture a URL or CDP target into a new scan (scan_interface)
  explore [options] <scanId>                 Explore safe interactions on a scan (explore_interactions)
  inspect [options] <scanId>                 Summarize or read a scan's UI DNA document (inspect_dna)
  element [options] <scanId> <stateId>       Inspect one node of a captured state (inspect_element)
  components [options] <scanId>              List fingerprinted component candidates (search_components)
  tokens [options] <scanId>                  Show token clusters of a scan (extract_tokens)
  annotate [options] <scanId> [patchesFile]  Apply agent annotations from a JSON file (annotate_dna)
  generate [options] <scanId> <outDir>       Generate a React project from a scan (generate_project)
  verify [options] <scanId> <outDir>         Compare a generated project with its scan (verify_reconstruction)
  report [options] <scanId>                  Write the static HTML report for a scan (report_reconstruction)
  export [options] <scanId>                  Write a portable evidence bundle (export_evidence)
  reconstruct [options] [url] <outDir>       Run scan → explore → generate → verify → report (reconstruct_interface)
  serve                                      Start the MCP server on stdio (what the registered command runs)
  setup [options]                            Register the MCP server in Claude Code, Codex and Cursor (prints the plan, asks, backs up)
  doctor [options]                           Report browser availability, CDP reachability and registration state
  help [command]                             display help for command
